title: HTTP-Triggered Azure Functions in Python
description: Runnable companion for the Azure Functions recipe: HTTP triggers, Cosmos DB bindings, async handlers, error middleware, timer/queue/blob triggers, FastAPI ASGI integration and deploy scripts.
